note: Hand-verified scouter ladders, keyed by card id. Every ladder here was read off the card face by eye, twice, because the OCR pass could not read it: foil and prismatic glare, artwork occluding rungs, double-width scans, 400x550 thumbnails, ladders in plain hundreds that a reader expecting six-figure values discards, and the all-Z ladders that carry no digits at all. Ladders are stored BOTTOM-FIRST - the zero stage is index 0 - with numeric rungs as numbers and Z rungs as the string "Z"; the printed zero stage ("00", "000", "0000", "00,000") normalises to 0. `pur` and `isPersonality` come from the same face read: several of these cards carry attack-worded power boxes and were misfiled as Combat cards, but the ladder plus PUR make them personalities. `note` says how the face was confirmed.
